instruction: A clean studio photograph, full-body medium-wide shot. In an indoor dance studio with a beige backdrop and white wall, two women are dancing side-by-side. On the left foreground, the brown-haired woman in the white crop top and black jeans (R1) dances with knees bent, looking forward with her mouth open. On the right background, the blonde woman in the white crop top and dark blue jeans (R3) leans back with legs spread, looking to the side. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting with warm beige and white tones.
